# Section 4 slack

About 100 KB of 0xFF after section 4, usable once the section end is raised.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x6079d800` to `0x607b6800` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Raise the section 4 end constant in the loader switch at 0x60045deb. Hooks inside section 4 that jump here need no boot guard.
